title: Incremental loader
description:
Because of how the CircleCI API is structured, we have to send a request per job in every project to get complete information. Jobs that have completed shouldn't mutate (I think), so we could incrementally load new jobs based on what's already in a SQLite database

It'll probably look similar to this workflow: https://github.com/dogsheep/github-to-sqlite/blob/70dffca351375e6f542969c72ebc43c6d393d99c/.github/workflows/deploy-demo.yml#L51-L93

This would also make an auto-updating demo more feasible
